headline: Newsroom Brief Reports BIR Deadline Extension to August 18 for Flood-Affected Taxpayers
seoTitle: Brief: BIR Deadline Extension to August 18
seoDescription: An FMB News brief reports that selected filing and payment deadlines were moved to August 18 for taxpayers in flood-affected areas.
deck: The newsroom package reports tax-filing relief for taxpayers affected by monsoon flooding.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The August 15 FMB News brief reports that BIR deadlines falling from August 13 to 15 were moved to August 18 for covered flood-affected taxpayers, with relief from penalties for qualifying filings.

The email's linked GMA page did not document the tax circular, and the brief named an outdated BIR commissioner. FMB News therefore omits the claimed signer and publishes the deadline extension only as a source-attributed newsroom report pending the actual revenue memorandum circular.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The inaccurate commissioner attribution was removed rather than repeated.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Tax deadline changes affect businesses, self-employed workers and accountants who may otherwise incur penalties during disaster disruptions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the exact BIR revenue memorandum circular, covered RDO list and official eFPS/eBIRForms guidance.
